blocks.zh: 藥典程序的確效驗證 完整教學版
blocks.en: Validation of Compendial Procedures: Complete Tutorial

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解USP <1225>在法規框架中的地位及其與21 CFR 211.194(a)的關聯
blocks.en: Understand the status of USP <1225> in the regulatory framework and its link to 21 CFR 211.194(a)

blocks.zh: 掌握分析程序確效的8大特性：準確性、精確性、特異性、偵測限、定量限、線性、範圍、穩健性
blocks.en: Master the eight analytical performance characteristics: accuracy, precision, specificity, detection limit, quantitation limit, linearity, range, and robustness

blocks.zh: 區分四大確效類別（Category I~IV）及其所需的分析性能特性
blocks.en: Distinguish the four validation categories (Category I to IV) and the analytical performance characteristics each requires

blocks.zh: 理解「確效（Validation）」與「驗證（Verification）」的核心區別
blocks.en: Understand the core difference between "validation" and "verification"

blocks.zh: 能夠根據分析方法類型選擇適當的確效方案和接受標準
blocks.en: Be able to select an appropriate validation approach and acceptance criteria based on the type of analytical method

blocks.zh: 了解再確效（Revalidation）的觸發條件
blocks.en: Know the triggers for revalidation

blocks.zh: Introduction & Legal Basis 簡介與法規基礎
blocks.en: Introduction & Legal Basis

blocks.zh: Original Text 原文內容
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 法規地位的三個關鍵要點：
blocks.en: Three key points on regulatory status:

blocks.zh: USP-NF藥典標準具有法律效力：依聯邦食品、藥品與化妝品法第501條，藥典專論中的分析方法構成法定標準
blocks.en: USP-NF standards carry legal force: under Section 501 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, the analytical methods in a compendial monograph constitute legal standards

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 211.194(a)：要求所有用於評估合規性的測試方法必須符合準確性和可靠性標準
blocks.en: 21 CFR 211.194(a): requires that all test methods used to assess compliance meet standards of accuracy and reliability

blocks.zh:
確效 vs. 驗證的重要區別：
- 藥廠使用USP官方方法 → 只需「驗證（Verification）」——詳見<1226>
- 提交新/修訂方法到USP → 必須進行完整「確效（Validation）」
blocks.en:
The key difference between validation and verification:
- A manufacturer using an official USP method → only needs "verification" (see <1226>)
- Submitting a new or revised method to USP → must perform full "validation"

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把USP藥典方法想像成「政府核可的食譜」：餐廳（藥廠）使用這份食譜時，只需確認自己廚房的爐具和食材適合（驗證/Verification）；但如果要修改食譜或提出新食譜讓政府批准（提交USP），就必須進行完整的測試和文件（確效/Validation）。
blocks.en: Think of a USP compendial method as a "government-approved recipe": a restaurant (the manufacturer) using that recipe only needs to confirm that its own stove and ingredients are suitable (verification). But if it wants to modify the recipe, or propose a new recipe for government approval (submission to USP), it must carry out full testing and documentation (validation).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 與ICH的協調：USP <1225> 盡量與ICH Q2(R1)「分析程序的確效」指引協調，使USP方法確效的要求與歐盟、日本、美國的藥品上市申請要求一致。這對CDMO客戶很重要——同一套確效資料原則上可以支持多個監管申請。
blocks.en: Harmonization with ICH: USP <1225> is harmonized as far as possible with the ICH Q2(R1) guideline "Validation of Analytical Procedures", so that USP method validation requirements align with those for marketing applications in the EU, Japan, and the US. This matters for CDMO clients: in principle, one set of validation data can support multiple regulatory filings.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家新設立的CDMO實驗室首次使用USP <71>無菌試驗，是否需要重新確效這個方法？依據哪個法規條款？
blocks.en: A newly established CDMO laboratory is using the USP <71> sterility test for the first time. Does it need to revalidate the method? Under which regulatory provision?

blocks.zh: 若客戶要求使用一個替代的HPLC方法（非USP官方方法）進行成品含量檢驗，需要進行什麼類型的確效？
blocks.en: If a client asks for an alternative HPLC method (not the official USP method) for finished-product assay, what type of validation is required?

blocks.zh: Accuracy 準確性
blocks.en: Accuracy

blocks.zh: 準確性的計算方式：
blocks.en: How accuracy is calculated:

blocks.zh: 回收率（Recovery %）：最常用方式 = (測量值/已知添加量) × 100%
blocks.en: Recovery (%): the most common approach = (measured value / known amount added) × 100%

blocks.zh: 偏差（Bias）：測量均值與真值的差異，搭配信賴區間表示
blocks.en: Bias: the difference between the mean measured value and the true value, expressed together with a confidence interval

blocks.zh: ICH最低要求：至少3個濃度水準，每個水準3份重複 = 最少9個測定值
blocks.en: ICH minimum requirement: at least 3 concentration levels with 3 replicates at each level = a minimum of 9 determinations

blocks.zh: 準確性就像射箭時箭落在靶心的距離——箭群平均落在靶心附近，就叫「準確」。精確性（Precision）則是箭群聚不聚攏（重現性）。可以有高精確性但低準確性（箭群很密集但偏離靶心），也可以有高準確性但低精確性（平均在靶心但散得很開）。兩者都重要，代表不同的誤差來源。
blocks.en: Accuracy is like how close arrows land to the bullseye in archery: if the cluster of arrows averages near the bullseye, the shooting is "accurate". Precision is whether the arrows group tightly together (reproducibility). You can have high precision with low accuracy (a tight cluster far from the bullseye), or high accuracy with low precision (an average on the bullseye but widely scattered). Both matter, and they reflect different sources of error.

blocks.zh: 加標回收（Spiking）是主要手段，但有限制：
blocks.en: Spike recovery (spiking) is the main approach, but it has limitations:

blocks.zh: 原料藥確效：用已知純度的參考標準品
blocks.en: Drug substance validation: use a reference standard of known purity

blocks.zh: 製劑確效：向空白製劑基質中添加已知量原料藥
blocks.en: Drug product validation: add a known amount of drug substance to a blank placebo matrix

blocks.zh: 雜質確效：向樣品中添加已知量雜質標準品；若無法取得，使用相對響應因子計算
blocks.en: Impurity validation: add a known amount of impurity standard to the sample; if it is not available, calculate using the relative response factor

blocks.zh: Spike需在分析方法的測定範圍內進行，不能超出線性範圍
blocks.en: Spiking must be done within the range of the analytical method and must not exceed the linear range

blocks.zh: 一個HPLC方法的含量測定範圍是80%~120%，準確性確效應在哪幾個濃度點進行？
blocks.en: An HPLC assay method has a range of 80% to 120%. At which concentration points should accuracy be validated?

blocks.zh: 若某降解產物沒有商業標準品，如何確效該雜質的準確性？USP允許什麼替代方案？
blocks.en: If a degradation product has no commercial standard, how can its accuracy be validated? What alternative does USP allow?

blocks.zh: Precision, Specificity, Detection & Quantitation Limits 精確性、特異性、偵測限與定量限
blocks.en: Precision, Specificity, Detection & Quantitation Limits

blocks.zh: 精確性的三個層次 Three Levels of Precision
blocks.en: Three Levels of Precision

blocks.zh: 重現性（Repeatability）：同一分析師、同一設備、同一天——最嚴格控制條件下的精確性
blocks.en: Repeatability: same analyst, same equipment, same day; precision under the most tightly controlled conditions

blocks.zh: 中間精確性（Intermediate Precision / Ruggedness）：不同天、不同分析師或不同設備——反映日常使用條件
blocks.en: Intermediate precision (ruggedness): different days, analysts, or equipment; reflects routine-use conditions

blocks.zh: 再現性（Reproducibility）：不同實驗室——用於合作研究、方法轉移評估
blocks.en: Reproducibility: different laboratories; used for collaborative studies and method transfer evaluation

blocks.zh: 對製藥QC而言，中間精確性最關鍵——反映了「在不同輪班、不同批次校正設備下，方法是否穩定」。
blocks.en: For pharmaceutical QC, intermediate precision is the most critical: it shows whether the method stays stable across different shifts and across equipment calibrated for different batches.

blocks.zh: 偵測限 vs. 定量限的比喻 DL vs. QL Analogy
blocks.en: DL vs. QL Analogy

blocks.zh: 把分析師想像成聽診器聽心音的醫生：偵測限是他「能聽到有什麼聲音」的最低閾值——可以確認「有/無」；定量限是他能「準確描述心跳速率」的最低閾值——能給出可靠的數字。偵測限用於限量試驗（pass/fail），定量限用於含量測定。信噪比：DL用2:1或3:1，QL用10:1。
blocks.en: Think of an analyst as a doctor listening to heart sounds with a stethoscope. The detection limit is the lowest threshold at which the doctor can tell that "there is some sound", which confirms presence or absence. The quantitation limit is the lowest threshold at which the doctor can "accurately describe the heart rate", giving a reliable number. The detection limit is used for limit tests (pass/fail), and the quantitation limit for quantitative assays. Signal-to-noise ratio: 2:1 or 3:1 for DL, 10:1 for QL.

blocks.zh: 特異性確效實作 Specificity Validation Practice
blocks.en: Specificity Validation Practice

blocks.zh: 鑑別試驗：測試含分析物的樣品（應陽性）+ 不含分析物但含結構相似物的樣品（應陰性）
blocks.en: Identification tests: test a sample containing the analyte (should be positive) and a sample without the analyte but containing structurally similar substances (should be negative)

blocks.zh: 雜質試驗（色譜法）：加標已知雜質，確認定量準確；用DAD或MS確認峰純度
blocks.en: Impurity tests (chromatographic): spike with known impurities to confirm accurate quantitation; use DAD or MS to confirm peak purity

blocks.zh: 含量測定：加標雜質或賦形劑，確認分析結果不受干擾
blocks.en: Assay: spike with impurities or excipients to confirm that the result is not affected by interference

blocks.zh: 強制降解試驗（Forced Degradation）：光照、熱、酸/鹼/氧化應激——確認方法能分離降解產物
blocks.en: Forced degradation: light, heat, acid/base, and oxidative stress, to confirm that the method can separate the degradation products

blocks.zh: 關鍵指標公式 Key Formulas
blocks.en: Key Formulas

blocks.zh:
精確性（%RSD）：
  %RSD = (標準差 / 均值) × 100

偵測限（信噪比法）：
  LOD = 3.3 × σ / S
  （σ = 基線噪聲標準差，S = 校正曲線斜率）

定量限（信噪比法）：
  LOQ = 10 × σ / S

可接受信噪比：
  LOD：S/N ≥ 2:1 或 3:1
  LOQ：S/N ≥ 10:1
blocks.en:
Precision (%RSD):
  %RSD = (standard deviation / mean) × 100

Detection limit (based on standard deviation of the response and slope):
  LOD = 3.3 × σ / S
  (σ = standard deviation of the response (baseline noise), S = slope of the calibration curve)

Quantitation limit (based on standard deviation of the response and slope):
  LOQ = 10 × σ / S

Acceptable signal-to-noise ratio:
  LOD: S/N ≥ 2:1 or 3:1
  LOQ: S/N ≥ 10:1

blocks.zh: HPLC含量測定方法，重現性（Repeatability）確效應做幾份？如何在方案中設計？
blocks.en: For repeatability validation of an HPLC assay method, how many preparations should be run, and how should this be designed in the protocol?

blocks.zh: 一個雜質限量試驗只需要「是否超過0.1%」的pass/fail判斷，需要確效到定量限還是偵測限？
blocks.en: An impurity limit test only needs a pass/fail decision on "does it exceed 0.1%". Should it be validated down to the quantitation limit or the detection limit?

blocks.zh: 強制降解試驗在特異性確效中的目的是什麼？如果降解產物與主峰共溶出，說明方法有什麼問題？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of forced degradation in specificity validation? If a degradation product co-elutes with the main peak, what does that say about the method?

blocks.zh: Linearity, Range, Robustness & System Suitability 線性、範圍、穩健性與系統適用性
blocks.en: Linearity, Range, Robustness & System Suitability

blocks.zh: 線性確效的實作重點 Linearity Validation Practice
blocks.en: Linearity Validation Practice

blocks.zh: 最少5個濃度點（ICH建議），涵蓋測定範圍
blocks.en: At least 5 concentration points (ICH recommendation), covering the range of the method

blocks.zh: 報告項目：相關係數(r²)、y截距、斜率、殘差平方和
blocks.en: Items to report: correlation coefficient (r²), y-intercept, slope, and residual sum of squares

blocks.zh: 視覺檢查優先：先繪圖肉眼確認，再做統計回歸
blocks.en: Visual inspection first: plot the data and check by eye before running the statistical regression

blocks.zh: 接受標準：r² 通常要求 ≥0.999（含量測定）；截距應接近零
blocks.en: Acceptance criterion: r² is usually required to be ≥0.999 (for assays); the intercept should be close to zero

blocks.zh: 粒徑分析例外——不適用傳統線性定義，用濃度範圍不影響粒徑分佈結果來定義
blocks.en: Particle size analysis is an exception: the traditional definition of linearity does not apply, and linearity is instead defined as the concentration range not affecting the particle size distribution result

blocks.zh: 穩健性的比喻 Robustness Analogy
blocks.en: Robustness Analogy

blocks.zh: 穩健性就像測試一張食譜能不能應對「現實廚房」的小變化——烤箱溫度差5度、麵粉品牌換了、攪拌時間多30秒，成品還能達標嗎？對HPLC方法而言，就是測試：pH差0.2、有機溶劑比例差5%、柱溫差5°C、流速差0.1 mL/min——系統適用性（resolution、tailing factor）是否還合格？
blocks.en: Robustness is like testing whether a recipe can cope with small changes in a "real kitchen": the oven temperature is off by 5 degrees, the flour brand has changed, the mixing time is 30 seconds longer. Can the finished dish still meet the standard? For an HPLC method, the same test asks: with pH off by 0.2, organic solvent ratio off by 5%, column temperature off by 5°C, and flow rate off by 0.1 mL/min, does the system suitability (resolution, tailing factor) still pass?

blocks.zh: 系統適用性 vs. 穩健性的關係 System Suitability vs. Robustness
blocks.en: System Suitability vs. Robustness

blocks.zh: 穩健性（Robustness）：方法開發/確效階段進行，目的是找出關鍵參數，設定合理的操作範圍。
blocks.en: Robustness: performed during method development/validation, to identify critical parameters and set reasonable operating ranges.

blocks.zh: 系統適用性（System Suitability）：每次分析前運行，確認當次分析系統狀態符合要求。穩健性確效結果告訴你「系統適用性指標應設多嚴格」。兩者是因果關係。
blocks.en: System suitability: run before each analysis to confirm that the system meets requirements for that run. The robustness results tell you how tight the system suitability criteria should be. The two are related as cause and effect.

blocks.zh: 各類方法的線性範圍要求 Range Requirements by Category
blocks.en: Range Requirements by Category

blocks.zh:
含量測定（原料藥/製劑）：
  80% ~ 120%（相對於試驗濃度）

雜質測定：
  50% ~ 120%（相對於接受標準）

含量均勻度：
  70% ~ 130%（相對於試驗濃度）

溶出度試驗：
  規格範圍 ± 20%
  例：緩控釋 30%~90%，則範圍為 10%~110%
blocks.en:
Assay (drug substance/drug product):
  80% to 120% (of the test concentration)

Impurity determination:
  50% to 120% (of the acceptance criterion)

Content uniformity:
  70% to 130% (of the test concentration)

Dissolution testing:
  Specification range ± 20%
  Example: for a modified-release product with 30% to 90%, the range is 10% to 110%

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在CDMO場景中，方法轉移（Method Transfer）時通常需要確認中間精確性和特異性（在接收方實驗室的基質條件下）。若轉移協議要求完整確效，需要全套8個特性；若只是「使用已驗證方法」，則依<1226>進行驗證即可。建議在方法轉移協議（MTA）中明確界定確效vs.驗證的範疇，避免做了不必要的確效工作或少做了必要的驗證。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, method transfer usually requires confirming intermediate precision and specificity (under the matrix conditions of the receiving laboratory). If the transfer protocol requires full validation, all eight characteristics are needed; if it is only a case of "using a validated method", verification per <1226> is sufficient. It is advisable to define the scope of validation vs. verification clearly in the method transfer agreement (MTA), to avoid doing unnecessary validation work or omitting necessary verification.

blocks.zh: Validation Categories & Data Elements 確效類別與資料要素
blocks.en: Validation Categories & Data Elements

blocks.zh: 類別選擇邏輯 Category Selection Logic
blocks.en: Category Selection Logic

blocks.zh: 確效類別的選擇就像選擇建築工程的安全規範：建一棟家用小屋（鑑別試驗/Category IV）只需符合基本安全要求，不需要地震工程評估；建一棟高層辦公樓（含量測定/Category I）則需要完整的結構分析、材料測試和荷載驗算。
blocks.en: Choosing a validation category is like choosing safety codes for a construction project: a small family house (identification test / Category IV) only needs to meet basic safety requirements and no seismic engineering assessment, while a high-rise office building (assay / Category I) needs full structural analysis, materials testing, and load calculations.

blocks.zh: Category IV（鑑別試驗）的特殊性 Category IV Notes
blocks.en: Category IV Notes

blocks.zh: 鑑別試驗不需要準確性、精確性、偵測限、定量限和線性——因為結果只是「符合/不符合」，不是定量數值。但特異性是必須確效的——必須證明方法能區分出目標分析物，而不會對相似化合物給出假陽性。
blocks.en: An identification test does not require accuracy, precision, detection limit, quantitation limit, or linearity, because the result is only "conforms / does not conform", not a quantitative value. But specificity must be validated: the method must be shown to distinguish the target analyte without giving false positives for similar compounds.

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素試驗（BET/LAL test）屬於哪個確效類別？需要確效哪些性能特性？
blocks.en: Which validation category does the bacterial endotoxins test (BET/LAL test) belong to? Which performance characteristics need to be validated?

blocks.zh: HPLC有關物質試驗（帶定量接受標準）屬於Category II定量還是限量？為什麼精確性必要而偵測限不必要（或反之）？
blocks.en: Is an HPLC related substances test (with quantitative acceptance criteria) Category II quantitative or limit test? Why is precision necessary while detection limit is not (or vice versa)?

blocks.zh: 含量均勻度（Content Uniformity，CU）試驗屬於哪個Category？線性範圍要求是多少？
blocks.en: Which category does the content uniformity (CU) test belong to? What is the required linearity range?

blocks.zh: 在實際確效計畫（Validation Protocol）中，應明確寫明：(1) 方法類別（Category）、(2) 各特性的接受標準（明確數值，非僅「符合ICH要求」）、(3) 確效實驗的實驗設計（何時做、誰做、用什麼設備）、(4) 報告審核和批准流程。若後續有變更觸發再確效，要在確效報告中寫明再確效的觸發條件。
blocks.en: In an actual validation protocol, you should state clearly: (1) the method category, (2) the acceptance criteria for each characteristic (specific numerical values, not just "meets ICH requirements"), (3) the experimental design of the validation (when, by whom, using what equipment), and (4) the report review and approval process. If a later change triggers revalidation, the revalidation triggers should be stated in the validation report.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 法規地位：USP藥典方法具法律效力；藥廠使用時只需驗證（<1226>），提交USP時才需完整確效
blocks.en: Regulatory status: USP compendial methods carry legal force; manufacturers using them only need verification (<1226>), and full validation is needed only when submitting to USP

blocks.zh: 與ICH Q2協調：美國、歐盟、日本採用相同框架，確效資料可相互支持
blocks.en: Harmonization with ICH Q2: the US, EU, and Japan use the same framework, so validation data can support each other

blocks.zh: 8大特性：準確性、精確性、特異性、偵測限、定量限、線性、範圍、穩健性
blocks.en: Eight characteristics: accuracy, precision, specificity, detection limit, quantitation limit, linearity, range, robustness

blocks.zh: 準確性：最少9個測定值，3濃度×3重複；加標回收率或參考方法比對
blocks.en: Accuracy: at least 9 determinations, 3 concentrations × 3 replicates; spike recovery or comparison with a reference method

blocks.zh: 精確性三層次：重現性（同日同人）→ 中間精確性（不同日/人）→ 再現性（不同實驗室）
blocks.en: Three levels of precision: repeatability (same day, same analyst) → intermediate precision (different days/analysts) → reproducibility (different laboratories)

blocks.zh: 偵測/定量限：S/N 2~3:1（LOD）vs. 10:1（LOQ）；限量試驗用LOD，定量試驗用LOQ
blocks.en: Detection/quantitation limits: S/N 2 to 3:1 (LOD) vs. 10:1 (LOQ); limit tests use LOD, quantitative tests use LOQ

blocks.zh: 四個Category：I（含量測定）→ II（雜質定量/限量）→ III（性能特性）→ IV（鑑別）
blocks.en: Four categories: I (assay) → II (impurities, quantitative/limit) → III (performance characteristics) → IV (identification)

blocks.zh: Category IV：只需確效特異性，不需定量特性
blocks.en: Category IV: only specificity needs to be validated; no quantitative characteristics are required

blocks.zh: 穩健性：方法開發/確效時進行，結果決定系統適用性指標的嚴格程度
blocks.en: Robustness: performed during method development/validation; its results determine how tight the system suitability criteria should be
